{{Recipe}}

Algerians are very fond of '''m'semen''', a [[Cookbook:Flatbread|flatbread]] made from basic ingredients like flour, semolina, butter, and water. The dough can be sticky to the touch while folding, so oiling the hands is necessary. Some people also fill the pancakes with minced meat and vegetables before frying in oil until they become crisp and golden.

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Semolina|semolina]] flour
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* ¼ tsp instant [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]]
* 1 ½ cups warm water
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]]

== Procedure ==

# Combine both flours, sugar, salt, and yeast in a bowl.
# Gradually mix in the warm water until you get a soft [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]]. If it feels too sticky, mix in a little more all-purpose flour. If too dry, mix in some more water.
# On a lightly-floured surface, [[Cookbook:Kneading|knead]] the dough for 10 minutes or until it is smooth.
# Divide the dough into smaller pieces, and [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|roll]] each out into very thin rounds.
# [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] each dough round with oil.
# Fold the rounds into square envelope shapes, making 4 folds into the center.
# Cook each flatbread in a hot, lightly-greased [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] until browned.
